items.name: utils
items.title: Kineto utils
items.description: Small helpers shared by the Kineto registry components.

items.name: provider
items.title: Kineto provider
items.description: Mount once in the root layout: loads the stylesheet and starts Kineto.observe() so any data-kt-* element that reaches the DOM is animated and cleaned up automatically.
items.docs: Add <KinetoProvider> around your app once (a client component). Then put data-kt-* attributes on any shadcn component, e.g. <Card data-kt-tilt="tilt-glare">.

items.name: reveal
items.title: Kineto reveal
items.description: Viewport entrance for sections, cards and lists (fade/slide/zoom/mask/wipe/clock presets, stagger, once).

items.name: text-reveal
items.title: Kineto text reveal
items.description: Headline entrance where characters resolve into place; includes Korean jamo assembly (hangul) and decode/flicker/shuffle presets.

items.name: counter
items.title: Kineto counter
items.description: Animated KPI numbers: slot reels, pop landing, plain count-up, digit cycling and flip.

items.name: image
items.title: Kineto image
items.description: Lazy-loaded with a loading reveal (skeleton, blur-up, pixelate, print, dissolve, crt …). For dither/ASCII/halftone textures use the `stylize` item.

items.name: stylize
items.title: Kineto stylize
items.description: Draws an or

items.name: marquee
items.title: Kineto marquee
items.description: Seamless logo wall / announcement band with pause-on-hover and scroll-aware direction.

items.name: tilt-card
items.title: Kineto tilt card
items.description: Pointer-following 3D tilt with glare, or a pointer glow (spotlight, edge, border, comet, aurora, shine) for cards.

items.name: magnetic-button
items.title: Kineto magnetic button
items.description: Button that leans toward the pointer and springs back, with an optional click ripple.

items.name: presence
items.title: Kineto presence
items.description: Enter/exit motion for mounted content (dialog bodies, panels, route content) with named presets; the host keeps owning DOM removal.

items.name: page-reveal
items.title: Kineto page reveal
items.description: First-paint overlay (curtain, iris, blinds, data-mosaic …) that opens once the page is ready.

items.name: ai-rules
items.title: Kineto AI rules
items.description: Rules for coding agents (Cursor rule + Markdown): when to use which Kineto module next to shadcn/ui, Bootstrap, MUI, Mantine, Chakra, Ant Design, daisyUI, Nuxt UI, PrimeVue and Vuetify, and how to map Figma layers to intents.
items.docs: Cursor reads .cursor/rules/kineto.mdc automatically. For Claude Code or Codex, reference docs/kineto-ai-rules.md from CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md.
